text:
**Answer**

The only Outdoor Canada issue issued between 2023 and 2024 that carried a human figure (and thus no animal) on its cover was the **July – August 2023** edition. The cover shows a photograph of the outdoorswoman **Juliiathompson** (‑ “Under the Canadian stars with @juliiathompson, where every night feels like an adventure”).  
All of the other issues released in that 18‑month span (May – June 2023, September – October 2023, November – December 2023, January – February 2024, March – April 2024, etc.) feature either fish, game, or other wildlife on the front page.

**Sources**

1. Instagram post “Outdoor Canada Magazine July August 2023 Cover” – shows the cover photo with the text “Under the Canadian stars with @juliiathompson…”【search1†L1-L4】.  

Because only that cover lacks an animal, Juliiathompson is the sole individual appearing on the front of a 2023‑2024 Outdoor Canada issue that did not depict an animal.
